title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - FunctionalDevice
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/FunctionalDevice. Functional Devices are non-purely eHealth/ageing-well devices that can be used for modelling/detecting activities or behaviours of patients/users, like for example beacons that can detect indoor positioning of a patient in a house (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf saref:Device directly (NOT HealthDevice). ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.5 states it 'shall thus have exactly the same object and data properties' as plain SAREF Device -- no SAREF4EHAW-specific properties are declared for it, and SAREF core's own Device properties are out of this candidate's 21-class scope (SAREF core itself is not part of this translation).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'FunctionalDevice'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
